notes:
Demand generated from French national census sources (INSEE). Residence population: INSEE Filosofi 2021, a 200 m population grid (published at 200 m). Jobs and commute flows: INSEE MOBPRO 2020, the national home-work mobility survey giving municipality-to-municipality (commune) employed-worker flows measured at place of work. Jobs per municipality = sum of inbound MOBPRO flows; spread within each municipality to 200 m cells weighted by OpenStreetMap tertiary building floor area (offices x levels > retail > industry). Commute OD flows (commune to commune) are disaggregated to 200 m residence/work cell pairs (residence weighted by Filosofi population, work by the job weights). Driving times/distances computed with OSRM on the Ile-de-France OSM extract. Special demand (airports, universities, landmarks, stadiums, malls, parks) added with distance-decay. Map tiles and foundations built with Depot from OpenStreetMap + Overture.

Re-submitted after a `revalidate` on the publish issue (#6920) for release v1.0.1, which reset the data-quality answers. The census sources, disaggregation and routing described above are unchanged. The only demand change is the review fix requested in #6920: a hard cap of 200 people per pop (`enforce_max_pop_size(200)` after the commute merge, plus a guard in the OD disaggregation so the cell-pair cap can never produce an oversized pop), which took the map from 198,001 to 202,085 pops for the same 7,019,451 total daily trips. Previously scored medium (raw 0.37 / weighted 0.57) and confirmed by @ahkimn in #6925.
